title: Verification code for "Mixed Triple Metric Dimension of Polyhedral Graphs: Local Forcing and Extremal Families"

creators.name: Adawiyah, Robiatul
creators.affiliation: Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember, Surabaya, Indonesia

description: Computational verification accompanying the paper "Mixed Triple Metric Dimension of Polyhedral Graphs: Local Forcing and Extremal Families" by R. Adawiyah, Rinurwati and M. Nagaraj. Eleven independent checks over antiprisms, bipyramids and the icosahedron, reproducing every row of Table 2 of the paper in order. Four of the checks re-derive the internal steps of a proof rather than only its conclusion. Core Perl, no external dependencies, exact integer arithmetic throughout. The companion paper on the triangle-free regime is verified separately.
